sources.title: MiniMax H3 Acc LoRA: Official 8-Step PDD Distillation in ComfyUI
sources.snippet: MiniMax-H3-Acc-LoRAs (Hugging Face | VideoX-Fun | arXiv) is an official release from Alibaba PAI applying Parallel Decoding Distillation (PDD) to MiniMax H3. Two acceleration adapters render joint video plus synchronized audio in 8 or 4 sampler steps with no classifier-free guidance, and a dedicated ComfyUI node pack brings the release to native ComfyUI workflows.
